title: Jose's site and UI issues: Angelo's and Dinis's dev agents own them, Jose reviews
detail: Affects everyone: Angelo, Dinis and their dev agents would own 15 issues. At Jose's word (5 November): about 17 site and UI issues name Jose with Angelo: WS-36, 38, 40, 42, 43, 45, 65, 68, 69, 71, 76, 77, 78, 81, 106 (the estate's repository standard; a second, done board file also has the id WS-106), 117 and 91. WS-65 and WS-91 are already picked by dev@web-summit.dinis; the other 15 have nobody. Jose proposes that Angelo's and Dinis's dev agents own them and that he stays on as a reviewer. Jose keeps WS-18 (the demos), WS-37 and WS-157 (observability and the urgent notification, with Angelo), WS-39, WS-74, WS-108 and WS-154. Proposed by Jose; nothing changed on the board.
recommend: Yes, as Jose proposes; Angelo and Dinis say which dev agent takes which, and each picks its issues on the board
options: yes: dev@web-summit.angelo and dev@web-summit.dinis own them, Jose reviews
split them one by one at the stand-up
jose_position: yes, as proposed: dev@web-summit.angelo and dev@web-summit.dinis own the 15, Jose reviews, each issue names the dev agent that took it.
